repairs.quote: Yunara lets rip a prayer bead that deals (55/95/135/175/215 + (85% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 99% decaying over 1.5 seconds. It deals an additional (33/57/81/105/129 + (51% bonus Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Transcendent State - Arc of Ruin: Yunara fires a laser that deals (160/320/480 + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 99% decaying over 1 second. Cast time scales with permanent Attack Speed (?% / 100%). Arc of Judgment deals (50% ~ 100%) damage to minions and its tick damage executes low health minions. Arc of Ruin gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.

proposalDecisions.reason: 원래summary에 미니언배율과처형이 이미 언급되어 있으며 proposal자체도 두효과가요약에반영됐다고 인정한다. 별도로 실제rules누락은 이번에복원했다.
